t.ZINC_OXIDE.agn: In the EU it is allowed as a UV filter at up to 25% (Annex VI, entry 30; nano form 30a) and as a colourant (Annex IV). It may not be used in applications that can reach the lungs by inhalation (sprays).
t.ZINC_OXIDE.eff.0: Not used in applications that can reach the lungs by inhalation (sprays); the restriction concerns this route of exposure.
t.ZINC_OXIDE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 30: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit.
t.ZINC_OXIDE.reg.1: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 30a: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit. (Nano form.)
t.ZINC_OXIDE.reg.2: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex IV, entry 144: Permitted colourant.
t.ZINC_OXIDE.summary: A white mineral pigment and mineral UV filter.
t.ZINC_OXIDE.what: Reflects and scatters UV rays; protects the skin and gives the product whiteness.
